description: ol-style-name-case (issue #854): a Heritage short alias callee written non-lowercase is flagged like any other built-in. Heritage aliases carry no arity of their own, so the primitive tables cannot see them — they reach the lint through `signatures.ts`'s `heritageSurfaceSpellings()`, the enumerable definition of a Heritage surface spelling (issue #852). The lint judges CASING only: choosing `fd` over `forward` is a profile choice, not a style violation this code expresses (that is `ol-style-full-name`), so lowercase `fd` is clean here.

diagnostics.message: FD should be lowercase snake_case, like a learner would read it aloud.
